title: 第1580章 无敌叶小北第1579章 叶小北
lines: 叶小北，太强大了！
渡劫强者，在他的手中，犹如猪狗一般，被随意斩杀。
那股猩红的气息，犹如大道之力一般，无敌于天下。
杀！杀！杀！
叶小北无情杀戮，无人可挡，让百族颤抖，各族的宗老纷纷敢来，前来对抗叶小北。
但他已然无敌。
这些宗老也不是他的对手，一个个含恨死去，陨落在叶小北的手中。
“叶小北，听说你曾经是叶欢的徒弟。叶欢都只能躲起来，你一个弟子，竟然比师父还要嚣张。”
“就让我，和你一战吧！”
夜寒出手了。
他是圣族的宗老，无敌于世间，是无敌强大的渡劫巅峰强者，拥有稳定阴阳的实力。
双方展开了大战。
叶小北一身的血气滔天，犹如战神出世，魔神子嗣一般，横扫天地。
夜寒同样是恐怖的存在，拥有问鼎阴阳的实力，那可是神灵的力量，阴阳大道，太极两仪，是无比逆天的力量。
然而。
经过主宰者培养的叶小北太强了，经过一周的大战，终于将夜寒打败，让他骨骼断裂，鲜血挥洒。
就在这时。
夜寒却是突破了。
在巨大的压力之下，迈入了阴阳境界。
他沐浴在黑白圣光之中，仿佛掌控了天地一般，这是无敌的力量，这是神灵的境界，无法想象。
“哈哈，叶小北，您再逆天又如何？我突破了阴阳境界，我已经无敌！”
“此刻，我就是神！”
寒夜大笑，无比兴奋。
这时。
叶小北的左手之上，却是缓缓祭出了一把剑。
一把红色的剑。
一剑坠落！
寒夜宛如神灵的身躯，直接被劈开，下方的大陆，形成了一道千里的裂缝。
一剑开天地！
“不，不，我是阴阳境界，我是神灵！”
寒夜嘶吼着，灵魂却也只能够缓缓消散。
东方大陆，西方大陆，众人都震惊了！
叶小北，是神，是魔，无敌的天王！
妖孽之子！
“哈哈，我的帝子大人，我终于成功了！”
主宰出现了，像是一个枯瘦的老人，缓缓从圣城之中走出。
content_en:
Ye Xiaobei is so powerful!
The strong men who had overcome the tribulation were killed at will like pigs and dogs in his hands.
That scarlet aura is like the power of the Great Dao, invincible in the world.
kill! kill! kill!
Ye Xiaobei's ruthless killings, which were unstoppable, made hundreds of tribes tremble, and clan elders from all tribes dared to come and fight against Ye Xiaobei.
But he was already invincible.
These elders were no match for him. They died with hatred one by one and fell into the hands of Ye Xiaobei.
"Ye Xiaobei, I heard that you were once Ye Huan's disciple. Ye Huan could only hide, but you, a disciple, are even more arrogant than the master."
"Let me fight with you!"
Yehan took action.
He is the patriarch of the Saint Clan, invincible in the world, an invincible and powerful person at the peak of tribulation, possessing the strength to stabilize Yin and Yang.
A battle broke out between the two sides.
Ye Xiaobei's body was full of blood, as if the god of war was born and the demon god's son was sweeping across the world.
Ye Han is also a terrifying existence, possessing the strength to conquer Yin and Yang, which is the power of the gods. The Yin and Yang Dao and Tai Chi Liang Yi are incomparable forces that defy the heavens.
However.
Ye Xiaobei, who had been trained by the Master, was too strong. After a week of fighting, he finally defeated Ye Han, causing his bones to break and blood to flow.
Just then.
Ye Han made a breakthrough.
Under tremendous pressure, he entered the realm of yin and yang.
He was bathed in the black and white holy light, as if he controlled the world. This was invincible power, this was the realm of gods, unimaginable.
"Haha, Ye Xiaobei, what if you go against the will of heaven? I have broken through the realm of yin and yang, and I am invincible!"
"At this moment, I am God!"
Han Ye laughed, extremely excited.
At this time.
On Ye Xiaobei's left hand, a sword was slowly drawn out.
A red sword.
"Kill!"
A sword fell!
Han Ye was like a god whose body was split open, and a thousand-mile crack formed in the continent below.
One sword opens the world!
"No, no, I am the realm of yin and yang, I am a god!"
Han Ye roared, but his soul could only dissipate slowly.
Everyone in the Eastern Continent and the Western Continent was shocked!
Ye Xiaobei is a god, a demon, and the invincible king!
The son of a monster!
"Haha, my lord, I finally succeeded!"
The Lord appeared, like a skinny old man, slowly walking out of the Holy City.
